sentences.text:
This Court on 30.11.2017 disposed of the writ petition with a direction to respondent no. 4 i.e.
Tehsildar, Samba to conclude the proceedings pending before him by passing a speaking order within a stipulated period of time.

It is stated that the appeal filed by the petitioners is pending before respondent no. 3 since last two years and the same has not been decided on merits till date.
05.

It is stated that respondent nos. 2 & 3 are bent upon to disburse the compensation in favour of respondent nos. 5 to 32 only to exclude the rightful claim of the petitioners with respect to the land,
which is in ownership of both the petitioners and the respondents being joint owners.

06. It is further stated that in case compensation is disbursed in favour of the private respondents,
the petitioners would suffer an irreparable loss.

Learned counsel for the petitioners states that the petitioners would feel satisfied if the instant petition is disposed of with a direction to respondent no. 3 to decide the appeal of the petitioners within a reasonable period of time after affording an opportunity of being heard to both the parties.

07. Be that as it may, the instant petition is disposed of without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case with a direction to respondent no. 3 i.e. Additional Deputy Commissioner Samba (Collector Land Acquisition) to conclude the proceedings pending before him by passing a speaking order within a period of one month from the date of receipt of certified of this order after affording opportunity of being heard to both the parties.
However, it is directed that till the appeal which is pending before respondent no. 3, is decided, compensation shall not be disbursed in favour of the parties.
08. The writ petition is disposed of along with connected CM.
